releaseNotes: Added the Video & Image Editor with video trimming, clip arranging, GPU-assisted export, image cropping, drawing, clipboard copy, and save workflows.
Redesigned the Video Compressor, Reminders, and File Converter around simpler, clearer workflows.
Expanded Appearance settings with custom backgrounds and refined surface styling, plus smoother and faster scrolling throughout the app.
Improved video playback, frame stepping, timeline editing, export accuracy, and image editing behavior.
Enabled Edit in Rex's Toolkit in Windows file menus by default for new installs.
